notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We’ve squashed a number of bugs to improve your gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Shader Optimizations[/b]: Enjoy smoother visuals and better performance. If you encounter any unexpected magenta textures or effects, please report them to us.
[*] [b]Store Reset[/b]: We’ve emptied the in-game store in preparation for exciting new content.
[*] [b]Upcoming Features[/b]: We’re laying the groundwork for the next major feature update. Stay tuned!
[*] [b]Seasonal FX[/b]: Experience the changing seasons with new Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 11, 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATE NOTES[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Idle Clicks[/b]: Added 1 click per second (CPS). Whether you're playing or away, you'll always receive 1 CPS.
[*] [b]Reworked Customize Screen[/b]: The Customize screen now includes categories for easier navigation.
[*] [b]Steam Inventory Access[/b]: Added an "Open Steam Inventory" option to the Customize screen.
[*] [b]Store Button[/b]: The Store button is now active.
[*] [b]Steam Integration[/b]: Your Steam avatar and name will now be displayed in-game.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: Fixed an issue where achievements were not always being rewarded.
[*] [b]Resolution Display[/b]: Made improvements to address resolution display issues. Community feedback is encouraged to verify this fix.
[/list]

[h2]Extra Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Inventory" has been renamed to "Customize" to better align with future updates.
[*] Main buttons have been moved to the bottom center of the screen.
[*] The "Clicks Per Second" display has been relocated below the multiplier display to reduce confusion.
[*] Updated item descriptions (e.g., +1 multiplier) for better understanding.
[/list]
